content.title: Delta earnings, Fed commentary, mortgage rates: What to Watch
content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Thursday, October 9, including corporate earnings results from PepsiCo (PEP), Delta Air Lines (DAL), and Levi Strauss (LEVI); the latest commentary from Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell and other prominent officials; and weekly mortgage rate readings.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
